617:t_117:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight you! Because...!」

617:t_117:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight you! Because...!」

617:t_117:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Because that's $$ノノ$$'s job!」

617:t_117:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Because that's $$ノノ$$'s job!」

617:t_117:14.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will shatter it! Warrior who inherits the legacy of the civilization of fire, prepare yourself!!」

617:t_118:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_118:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Zen riddles, at this stage? Or are you trying to find yourself?」

617:t_118:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Answer me, heir to the blood of the beast.」

617:t_118:3.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't owe you an answer. ...Or rather, I've never even thought about it.」

617:t_118:4.en:
$$葵$$
「So I'll tell you how I feel right now! It's to keep a jerk I can't stand like you from throwing your weight around!」

617:t_118:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is enough. Come at me on nothing but your primal instinct.」

617:t_118:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A beast is beaten down by force! By my strength, this strength of mine!」

617:t_118:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Don't talk about people like they're stray dogs! I'll make you pay for those words, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

617:t_119:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_119:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Why must you be the one to fight for that?」

617:t_119:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Soldier or salaryman, it makes no difference! Everyone does what they can for peace!」

617:t_119:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「In my case, that means fighting in $$ダイ・ガード$$!!」

617:t_119:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A salaryman who protects the peace...」

617:t_119:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But standing before me, rank and title mean nothing! Just show me your own strength!」

617:t_120:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_120:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Above all else, I love freedom. I will simply meet anyone who obstructs it with a resolute stance.」

617:t_120:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If I can hear that, no further words are necessary.」

617:t_120:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...I had wanted to speak with you, including about the matter of $$ガイオウ$$, but it seems that is impossible.」

617:t_120:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You seem to use words as your weapon, but for now you will indulge my way of doing things.」

617:t_120:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, then...! Now show me your power!」

617:t_120:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I am well accustomed to dealing with this sort of brute. Though not by choice.」

617:t_120:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! Then $$ビッグオー$$ and I shall face you in your own style!」

617:t_121:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_121:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「To punch out a guy like you, who acts all high and mighty and wrecks people's happiness!」

617:t_121:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Rather crude for one who pilots a mechanical angel.」

617:t_121:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then you're awfully smug for a $$次元将$$!」

617:t_121:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am what I am. No matter what happens.」

617:t_121:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And to that end, you will offer up your strength to me!」

617:t_121:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Like hell I'll let you have your way! It's a showdown, $$次元将$$!」

617:t_122:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_122:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「To take down a guy like you, who plays the ruler and steals people's happiness!」

617:t_122:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Rather weak for one who pilots a mechanical angel.」

617:t_122:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's true I don't have power like $$アポロ$$ or $$カグラ$$! But there's something I won't lose to anyone at!」

617:t_122:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And what is that?」

617:t_122:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「What a man you are...」

617:t_122:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! Then show me that love!」

617:t_122:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You don't need to tell me! Here I come, $$次元将$$!!」

617:t_123:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_123:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If you cannot answer, begone. I have no use for such a person.」

617:t_123:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's how it is... People like you ignore how we feel and just force things on us...」

617:t_123:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's wrong for someone like that to do whatever they want with the world!」

617:t_123:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you too are a warrior after all...」

617:t_123:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! I acknowledge you as a man worthy of fighting me!」

617:t_124:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_124:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「For peace, for the future...」

617:t_124:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And above all, for $$ティファ$$!!」

617:t_124:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Without a single doubt, you come at me with those feelings as they are...!」

617:t_124:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I acknowledge your fight! And you will offer up your strength to me!」

617:t_124:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Shut up! You've got no right to say anything about how I feel for $$ティファ$$!」

617:t_124:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's go, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I'll beat you and end this war!!」

617:t_125:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_125:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「For the people who live in this world!」

617:t_125:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You can fight for something so abstract?」

617:t_125:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「A man who can speak of life that way has no business being an emperor!」

617:t_125:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who can't feel the living must not rule the world!」

617:t_125:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...You may be right.」

617:t_125:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will fight as a general, not as an emperor! That is how I live!!」

617:t_126:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_126:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To see where humanity is headed... and to eliminate those who stand in its way.」

617:t_126:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even though you yourself are a forerunner?」

617:t_126:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There's only so much one person can do. It's humanity as a whole that advances into the future.」

617:t_126:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So I'll protect it...! That is my fight!」

617:t_126:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will strike you down!」

617:t_126:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Not to halt humanity's evolution, but because I acknowledge you as one of the greatest warriors in this universe!」

617:t_127:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_127:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A petty reason for one who holds a power rare even in the universe.」

617:t_127:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A man who calls the existence of life petty...!」

617:t_127:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! You are someone who must not exist!」

617:t_127:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I cannot stop...! For the sake of the lives I have taken until now!」

uncertain: Bare 次元将 (Apollo/Amata addressing Vildark) uses keyword token $$次元将$$; Roger's 次元将ヴィルダーク uses $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$ as in earlier slices.
